ai.title: Ask our sourcing assistant
ai.subhead: Get grounded answers about capabilities, certifications, and categories — then route complex requests to our team.
ai.emptyPrompt: Ask about capabilities, certifications, categories, or facilities.
ai.disclaimer: Answers are generated from our published capability data and may not reflect real-time capacity.
ai.fallbackError: I couldn't reach the assistant right now. Please use the Contact page and our team will respond directly.

prompts.question: Can you produce GOTS-certified organic cotton activewear at [X] units per month?
prompts.answer: Based on our published capability data, we support certified organic cotton activewear across selected facilities. Capacity varies by season and program — connect with our team for a current availability review.

prompts.question: Which of your facilities support GOTS-certified organic cotton programs?
prompts.answer: GOTS-certified organic cotton programs are listed among our activewear and kidswear capabilities at selected facilities. Specific facility assignments depend on order profile and compliance requirements.

prompts.question: What sustainability certifications do you currently hold?
prompts.answer: Certifications including GOTS, OEKO-TEX, and WRAP appear in our published governance materials. Certification scope varies by facility and product line.
